## Columbus Crew Welcomes Northwest Bank as Official Partner, Cuts Ribbon on Northwest Bank Gate


---


*Northwest Bank and Columbus Crew leaders cut a ribbon outside the new Northwest Bank Gate at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field on October 21, 2026. Pictured left to right: Dan Lentz, Vice President, Corporate Partnerships, Columbus Crew; Urich Bowers, Chief Consumer Banking and Strategy Officer, Northwest Bank; Devin Teles-Cygnar, Chief Marking and Communications Officer, Northwest Bank; Mary Shepro, President of Business Operations, Columbus Crew; Jay DesMarteau; Chief Commercial Banking Officer, Northwest Bank; Ged Tarpey Chief Revenue Officer, Columbus Crew; and Ronald Cordaro, Middle Market Relationship Manager, Northwest Bank*


### The partnership reflects Northwest's growing investment in Central Ohio and commitment to the Columbus community.


**COLUMBUS, Ohio (October 21, 2026)** – Northwest Bank today announced a new partnership with the Columbus Crew that brings the Northwest Bank name to one of the most prominent entry points at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field: the newly designated Northwest Bank Gate. Located on the stadium's northwest side adjacent to Astor Park, the Northwest Bank Gate will serve as a welcoming gateway for thousands of Crew supporters.


“Columbus is an important part of our growth story, and this partnership with the Columbus Crew is just one of the many ways in which we are deepening our connection with the region,” said Louis J. Torchio, president and CEO of Northwest Bank. “The Northwest Bank Gate is a visible symbol of our dedication to Central Ohio and an opportunity to connect with Crew supporters.”


“We are pleased to welcome Northwest Bank as an official partner of the Columbus Crew and to unveil the Northwest Bank Gate,” said Mary Shepro, President of Business Operations for the Columbus Crew. “Northwest shares our commitment to creating memorable experiences for supporters and making a positive impact across our community.”


Once inside the stadium, Crew fans will see Northwest Bank’s logo displayed on the ribbon LED and stadium video and tunnel boards. Fans listening to iHeart Radio will hear Northwest mentioned during pre- and post-match broadcasts.


The partnership marks another milestone in Northwest's expanding presence across Central Ohio. The bank recently opened a[financial center in New Albany, its first in Central Ohio](https://www.northwest.bank/link/4fc5fa26669043aab2d49a304872069e.aspx) , and one n[ext to The Ohio State University](https://www.northwest.bank/link/53cfca6e40e64fa9bf20abf2d87cf342.aspx) , with three more set to open in the Columbus market by early 2027. Northwest also recently announced plans to build and[open a new headquarters in 2029 in Dublin](https://www.northwest.bank/link/ba2c29fde9314e5ca19a01b31603fdf6.aspx) ’s Bridge North development.


### About Northwest Bank


Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Northwest Bancshares, Inc. is the bank holding company of Northwest Bank. Founded in 1896, Northwest Bank is a full-service financial institution offering a complete line of business and personal banking products, as well as employee benefits and wealth management services. Currently, Northwest operates 153 full-service financial centers and 11 drive-up locations across Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio, and Indiana and provides customers fee-free access to more than 55,000 ATMs. Additional information regarding Northwest Bancshares, Inc. and Northwest Bank can be accessed online atwww.northwest.bank .
